finding: Rendering is a plugin module, not part of Game.dll or Engine.dll.

evidence_static.game_folder_renderer: Direct3D11.dll, 141312 bytes, plus Direct3D.dll, DirectInput.dll, DS8Sound.dll, Widget.dll

why_it_matters: The presentation stack has a small, explicit interface: a 141 KB plugin exporting a documented RenderDevice subclass. That makes it a far better reversal target than the multi-megabyte engine, and the export table itself is the contract to recover against.
next_reversal_steps: Read Initialize (0x5af0) and CreateSwapChain (0x3f70) with Rea: device, swapchain and window binding.
Read CreatePrimarySurface (0x6480) to learn how an EWindow becomes the back buffer.
Read BeginFrame (0x7b90) / EndFrame (0x6470) / PresentSurface (0x7c40) for the per-frame present contract.
Recover the RenderDevice vtable order so a rebuilt device can be substituted behind the same interface.
Only then can a host present recovered frames; nothing of this is claimed yet.
